lower-middle.notes: Sleeve boundaries measured at y700, y1500 and y2400 in the EXIF-oriented 4032x3024 original. Endpoints conservatively inset to y650..2600 and extrapolated only 50px above /200px below the measured cuts. Each side is independently traced; wide Mahler box and leaning Rampal/Laskine spine use measured seams. Thin, heavily worn or overlapping sleeve edges are estimates bounded by adjacent visible sleeves; all catalog IDs are retained, with the three Bowie titles mapped to photographed physical order. Shapes deliberately avoid exposed interior wall and the white outer frame. The last sleeves end far left of the opening right boundary; slot67 specifically follows the cream Japanese Melodies sleeve. Central strips are represented, excluding ragged folded tips and some sleeve ends.
lower-middle.sourceOrientation: EXIF orientation3 applied; browser displayed pixels

upper-middle.notes: Two physical compartments. Individually measured source x seam anchors at y700 and y2400, with side-edge interpolation at y1500. Endpoints are conservatively inset to y650..2550, excluding the front divider, exposed interior and folded ragged tips. Nitty Gritty Dirt Band three-record box, Pink Floyd double sleeve and Elton John sleeve retain their measured larger widths. Unreadable, heavily worn or partly overlapping seams use bounded estimates; all68 original catalog IDs are retained. The rightmost cream sleeve is inset from the angled exposed white interior wall.

right.notes: Manual conservative 6-point sleeve traces in EXIF-transposed (browser displayed) 4032x3024 photo coordinates. Top caps, y1500 middle edges, and individual bottom contours are measured independently from visible spines and readable artist/title/catalogue anchors. These masks exclude white box framing, divider gaps, empty top/bay regions, and inter-sleeve black gaps; they are not uniform compartment subdivisions. Very small worn-edge sections between measured anchors are interpolated, with a 2px inset (1px on unresolved slot30). Slots04/30 retain the catalogue uncertainties. Book52 and 3LP box53 have separately measured broad tapered contours. Top-cap x positions use short local interpolation from the measured y500 edge; microcreases and torn fringe are not pixel-perfect segmentation.
